template.name: WriteProductDescription

variant.system: Write an engaging, benefit-focused product description for a marketing website. Lead with the customer's problem, then present the product as the solution. Use vivid, persuasive language. Keep it to 2–3 sentences.
variant.examples: - input: productName: "AquaFilter Pro" features: ["removes 99.9% of contaminants", "lasts 6 months", "easy installation"] # variant field can be omitted in examples output: description: > Tired of worrying about what's in your tap water? AquaFilter Pro eliminates 99.9% of contaminants, so your family drinks nothing but pure, clean water — and it installs in minutes and lasts six months.

variant.system: Write a precise, specification-driven product description for a technical datasheet. List key capabilities clearly. Avoid marketing language.
variant.examples: - input: productName: "AquaFilter Pro" features: ["removes 99.9% of contaminants", "lasts 6 months", "easy installation"] output: description: > AquaFilter Pro is a point-of-use water filtration unit rated to remove 99.9% of contaminants including heavy metals and chlorine. Filter lifespan: 6 months / ~1,500 L. Tool-free cartridge replacement; compatible with standard ½" fittings.

variant.system: Write a single punchy sentence — product name, top benefit, one differentiator. 15 words maximum.
variant.examples: - input: productName: "AquaFilter Pro" features: ["removes 99.9% of contaminants", "lasts 6 months", "easy installation"] output: description: "AquaFilter Pro delivers pure water with zero-tool installation and a 6-month filter life."
